observations: A metal pedestrian gate at a fenced pool enclosure is visible in an open position.
The gate leaf does not appear to be aligned with the latch post.
residentReportedFacts: The resident states the gate will not latch.
The resident states the gate swings open again after being closed.
The resident states they attempted to close it twice.
analysis.urgencyReason: A controlled-access pool gate that does not secure may create a safety and access-control concern for the community.
missingInformation: A close-up photo of the latch assembly would confirm whether the latch or the alignment is the failure point.

draft.workOrderTitle: East Pool Entry Gate Will Not Latch
draft.workOrderDescription: Inspect the east pool entry gate (asset PG-002) and its latch assembly. The gate was photographed in an open position and the resident reports it will not latch and swings back open. Latch alignment was adjusted on 2026-08-12 and hinges were serviced on 2026-05-03, so check whether the prior adjustment has shifted. Verify self-closing and self-latching operation against pool access-control requirements before leaving the site. The asset is under warranty through 2027-05-31 with SecureGate Systems; confirm warranty coverage before any billable parts are ordered.
draft.residentAcknowledgement: Thank you for reporting the east pool gate. Your request has been received and is being reviewed by the management team. We have a record of this gate and its recent service history, and a manager will confirm next steps shortly. Please do not attempt to repair or force the gate yourself.
draft.managerSummary: The request appears to involve the east pool entry gate (PG-002), which is still under warranty with SecureGate Systems and had a latch adjustment last month. The photo shows the gate open but does not by itself prove the latch failed. Confirm whether this is a recurrence of the August adjustment before approving billable work.
